3682-4659-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3682-4659-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mox Amber, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

728-5170-6132-8175.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

549-1651-2034-5261-8116.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Frontline Rush without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Frontline Rush, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Biotransference.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

2869-3184-6495--173.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature that costs {0}.
Yomiji triggers, returning that creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.
2869-3184-6495--173.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

874-2866-4986-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-4986-6495.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
874-2866-4986-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1429-3545-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Repeat.

277-851-4094-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-851-4094-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

851-1308-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4772-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4772-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1144-2071-2645-6871.easyPrerequisites: Wolfwillow Haven is attached to Staff of Domination.
1144-2071-2645-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Wolfwillow Haven triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

849-3967-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
849-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Anax and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2292-3621-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-3621-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

3398-3975-7025.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger
3398-3975-7025.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and Avatar Roku twice.
Resolve both Avatar Roku triggers, adding twelve {R}.
Resolve the first Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

1874-2034-3490-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-2034-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

933-6995-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
933-6995-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Lulu by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3750-5917-6985.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
3750-5917-6985.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
3750-5917-6985.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a copy of Goldlust Triad that is a 1/1 Balloon creature token with flying and haste.
Declare Goldlust Triad and the Goldlust Triad token as attackers, triggering their myriad abilities, creating two Goldlust Triad tokens attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with all Goldlust Triads, triggering their abilities, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-5917-6985.notes: You can forego making additional Goldlust Triads in step 1, although doing so allows the combo to scale further.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

270-1987-4423-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

372-1987-2974.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Ghostly Flicker.
372-1987-2974.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

864-1312-2034-4871-6791.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1315-5531-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
1315-5531-6621-6664.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

570-800-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Faeburrow Elder.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}{B}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.
570-800-4116.notes: If you control a red permanent, this combo will net infinite white, black, red and green mana.

413-603-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
413-603-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

1013-2178-3523.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1013-2178-3523.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2512-4594-5306.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Spirit en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Spirit en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1462-2232-2413-2768-4506.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 8.
You have not cast a spell using Demon of Fate's Design's ability this turn.
You control at least seven nontoken creatures.
1462-2232-2413-2768-4506.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying 7 life due to Demon of Fate's Design.
When Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, exiling all creatures you control and creating that many 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
When the Dragon(s) enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve all but one Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the final Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Day of the Dragons to your hand from the battlefield.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return all cards exiled with Day of the Dragons to the battlefield.
 When the creatures that were exiled by Day of the Dragons enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Auriok Champion trigger that many times.
Resolve all Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the number of creatures that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control eight or more nontoken creatures, this combo nets infinite life.

1988-2034-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Scurry Oak.
You control at least one additional creature.
1988-2034-4186.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

2-974-2472.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
2-974-2472.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Song of the Worldsoul triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may use Song of the Worldsoul's trigger to target any other token you control instead.

824-1295-2464-2541.notablePrerequisites:
At least one +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
One or two lore counters on Song of Freyalise.
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
824-1295-2464-2541.description:
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle triggers.
In response, activate Leech Bonder's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder's second ability by paying {U} and untapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Benthic Biomancer to Thassa's Oracle.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder's second ability by paying {U} and untapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Thassa's Oracle to Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 until the number of cards in your library is equal to your devotion to {U}.
Resolve Thassa's Oracle's ability, winning the game.

578-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
578-3263-4222.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least one artifact card from your hand, adding at least {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

238-2034-2281.description:
Activate Saffi Erikdotter by sacrificing itself, making it so the next time Gerrard dies this turn it will be returned to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gerrard, adding {C}{C}.
Saffi Eriksdotter and Gerrard triggers.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter trigger, returning Gerrard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards that were put into your graveyard this turn from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1447-1734-5256.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

575-1794-2899.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional black card in hand.
575-1794-2899.description:
Cast Ruthless Ripper by paying {B}.
Ruthless Ripper dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Ruthless Ripper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face-up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-1785-2577.notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Zombie.
1636-1785-2577.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

250-779-1307.description:
Activate Earsplitting Rats by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Earsplitting Rats ability, regenerating it.
Repeat.
